notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. Track E3 group pl-melee: build track-e3.md section E3-5 group pl-melee. Three commits, in this order: 'Minecraft knockback hits on players slow the attacker and end its sprint like vanilla', 'Minecraft knockback hits on mobs slow the attacker like vanilla', 'A Minecraft sweep round a mob reaches the players beside it only when the mob was hurt'.

Key points:
- The recoil (vanilla Player.causeExtraKnockback): a landed hit whose knockback strength is above 0 (a Knockback level, or a sprint at full strength) multiplies the attacker's horizontal velocity by 0.6 and ends its sprint.
- Add SimWorld::knockback_recoil right after set_sprint_blocked in crates/sim/src/frame.rs, plus its forwarder in carrier.rs. It scales MW2 velocity axes 0 and 1, keeps axis 2, and calls movement_iw4::end_sprint with set_sprint_blocked's default UserCmd.
- Player hits: pvp.rs PvpHit.recoil is set at :162-163. punch_player sets the attacker's own PlayerOutputs.recoil (new field next to pushes). minecraft_players.rs struck calls authority.knockback_recoil before the pushes loop (:949).
- Mob hits: MobOutcome.recoil and MobResult.recoil go next to broken. mob_actions::attack sets result.knockback || bonus.knockback > 0.0 after its !result.hurt return. The route at entities.rs:358-366 ORs it into out.recoil.
- Sweeps: MobOutcome and MobResult.sweep_from = Some(mob id) when result.hurt && result.sweep. punch stores (id, pvp Attack, bounds) in PlayerQueue.sweep_waiting instead of striking at :979-984. A new Entities::strike_sweeps runs after the route block in tick (:1742-1747), takes the matching entry and runs pvp::swept and strike_players. Results without sweep_from leave the entry alone.
- Do not touch MeleePush (M1's hook) or the Body trait.
- Log decisions: a blow fully stopped by the victim's shield still recoils (the attacker side decides); sweeps are paired by mob id.
- Tests as listed in the section (sim frame, pvp, entities, mob_actions). No protocol change.

Track E3 group pl-fire-aspect: build track-e3.md section E3-5 group pl-fire-aspect. Two commits: 'Minecraft Fire Aspect sets mobs alight like vanilla', then 'Minecraft Fire Aspect sets players alight like vanilla'.

Key points:
- Vanilla (fire_aspect.json post_attack and Ignite): a landed blow or a sweep blow gives the victim 4 s plus 4 s per level above the first. Ticks are Mth.floor(s*20), scaled by BURNING_TIME (Fire Protection) for living victims, and only ever raised. Ignite clears freezing.
- melee.rs: FIRE_ASPECT, fire_aspect_ticks(level) and weapon_fire_ticks(stack). WeaponBonus stays unchanged.
- Mobs: in mob_actions::attack, after death_remains (so a killing blow drops raw meat), raise world.body_mut(id).fire_ticks for the target and every result.swept id. mob_actions::sweep does the same; fire_ticks is passed through ServerSim::mob_sweep, Command::MobSweep, the handle method, its dispatch and punch_player (entities.rs:696).
- Players: pvp Attack.fire_ticks (filled in pvp_attack) and pvp::Blow.fire_ticks (set in blow(), so sweep blows carry it). PlayerOutputs.burning: Vec<(usize, i32)> holds the hit index and ticks, recorded in strike_players. Add Survival::ignite(ticks) next to hurt; the small fireball path at survival.rs:837-839 uses it too. minecraft_players.rs struck enumerates the hits and ignites only a landed one, so a raised shield stops the fire.
- Do NOT add a field to MeleePush: it is M1's goats-ram hook this round (track-m1.md:1543). Log why the burn rides beside the hit.
- Thorns is out of scope.
- Tests as listed in the section. No protocol change. Note the MINECRAFT-SURVIVAL.md:462 wording under State doc changes.

Track E3 group pl-pushing: build track-e3.md section E3-5 group pl-pushing. Two commits: 'A sleeping Minecraft player pushes others with vanilla's small sleeping box', then 'Minecraft riders push players they bump into like vanilla'.

Key points:
- Vanilla: LivingEntity.push returns while sleeping, but aiStep always runs pushEntities. A sleeper therefore pushes walkers with its 0.2 x 0.2 SLEEPING_DIMENSIONS box at the bed and is never pushed. A passenger pushes with its own box.
- pm_flags::MC_SLEEPING = 0x0020_0000, right after MC_RIDING in playerstate_iw4. First rg the bit in movement_iw4, sim, net and playerstate_iw4, as round 8 did for MC_POWDER_WALKER.
- SimWorld::lie_in_bed(id, Option<bed>) goes right after ride (frame.rs, plus the carrier.rs forwarder). It wraps ride and sets or clears MC_SLEEPING; ride itself clears MC_SLEEPING. The bed holds at minecraft_world.rs:747/:750 and minecraft_players.rs:1491/:1496 switch to lie_in_bed; minecraft_riding keeps ride.
- Commit 1: PushBody.sleeping and PredictionRemoteBody.sleeping (world.rs:260, :3226). minecraft_push lets sleepers through the filter with half width 0.1 and height 0.2; the overlap becomes PUSH_HALF_WIDTH + other_half. pushable is unchanged.
- Commit 2: drop the riding filter at step.rs:1938, along with the now unread PushBody.riding and PredictionRemoteBody.riding fields.
- Update the tests a_player_lying_in_bed_is_held_like_a_rider_and_not_pushed (step.rs:2599, renamed) and the_push_respects_height_spectators_and_riders (:2551). Add frame and prediction tests as listed.
- M2 adds set_dolphins_grace after set_float in the same frame.rs and carrier.rs; keep E3's methods next to ride and set_sprint_blocked.
